acceptanceCriteria: Measured decision recorded: shared read possible or not, with the before/after wall and CPU of `corvint test --dry-run` on this repository
If adopted, both plans are byte-identical before and after
body: Measured 2026-10-18 on origin/main 6ceee260b (build 668): `corvint test --base HEAD~5 --dry-run` takes 4.0 s wall / 5.1 s CPU. CPU profile: compileAffectedGraph -> golang.observeDirectories/readSourceFile ~0.75-0.97 s, and testFillPlan -> gateselect.Select -> indexRepository (filepath.WalkDir + reads) ~0.9 s. Both walk and read the same Go sources in the same process. Investigate whether gateselect can take the source bytes/tokens the affected graph already read (or a shared per-invocation source cache keyed by path+blob), without changing either selection. Excluded: the reader-matching cost itself (separate ticket on path-literal matching).
title: corvint test scans the repository twice: the affected Go graph and gateselect.indexRepository each read every source (~0.8-1.0 s each per call)
